niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, light, modern interfaces that feel complete and information-rich without becoming visually cluttered. They like clear sectioning, strong hierarchy, compact but readable rows, and screens that show enough settings or items to feel finished. They generally favor airy spacing, polished app-like presentation, and explicit labels over vague or placeholder-like layouts. They also like concise copy and straightforward controls, but their preference for density vs. spaciousness changes depending on context.

criteria.description: Multiple clearly separated, well-labeled sections with coherent grouping and ordering.
Screens that show a fuller set of relevant settings, items, or controls so the page feels complete rather than empty.
Layouts that distribute content evenly across the screen and avoid large blank or placeholder-like areas.
Strong hierarchy in titles, headers, rows, and sections so the user can scan the screen easily.
Light, airy, polished UI styling with subtle separation rather than heavy dark canvases or overly weighty cards.
Specific, concrete labels and setting names that make the purpose of each item immediately clear.
Tight, row-based list presentation with clear item distinction and consistent row behavior.
Short, friendly, direct microcopy and onboarding text rather than verbose or overly technical explanations.
